title: Dimensions recovery and defaults boundary
purpose: Continue W1 Foundation with a narrow Dimensions recovery/defaults case after the General Posting Setup Page 314 route was parked.

smartDecision.whyNow: Dimensions are a separate W1 Foundation dependency and can be recovered without repeating the blocked Page 314 route.
fieldsAllowedToChange: Only explicitly selected dimension fields or dimension values if the case narrows them after source/evidence review.
smartDecision.risk: Repeating previously blocked global dimension assignment routes would create churn without proof.
smartDecision.fallback: If the dimension route is unclear, capture read-only UI diagnostics and park defaults before master data.

entryCriteria: TARGET-032F parked the Page 314 General Posting Setup route.
